title: Brew Fridge Short-Cycle
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brewfridge:compressor
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count(eval(state="on")) as cycles, avg(run_min) as avg_run_min by fridge _time
| where cycles>4 AND avg_run_min<5
| sort - cycles
description: Uses Brew-fridge compressor logs telemetry to monitor compressor short-cycling during fermentation control in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for cooling behavior that wastes energy or stresses equipment, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Brew-fridge compressor logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds compressor short-cycling during fermentation control so you can spot cooling behavior that wastes energy or stresses equipment before it becomes annoying.
